seo.title: Voice Easy — Voice Memos, Transcribed on Your iPhone
seo.description: Record voice memos in one tap and read them back. Voice Easy transcribes on your iPhone, records from Apple Watch, and keeps everything on your devices. No account, no cloud.

hero.label: VOICE RECORDER
hero.title: Talk now. Read it later.
text: Tap once to record. Voice Easy writes out what you said right on your iPhone, so you can read it back, search it and keep it private. No account, no cloud.

sections.label: FEATURES
sections.title: Everything you need, nothing you don’t.

items.title: One tap to record
items.text: The record button sits at the bottom of every screen. Recording keeps going with your iPhone locked, and a call pauses it instead of ending it.

items.title: Transcribed on your iPhone
items.text: Apple’s on-device speech recognition writes out every recording. Your voice is never uploaded, and recordings you don’t name are named from what you said.

items.title: Read along
items.text: The transcript follows playback. Tap any line to jump there, change the speed, or scrub the waveform.

items.title: Search every word
items.text: Find any recording by its name or by something you said in it.

items.title: Folders, your way
items.text: Keep recordings in folders with your own colors and glyphs, and mark your favorites.

items.title: Apple Watch
items.text: Record a memo from your wrist. It goes straight to your iPhone to be transcribed.

sections.label: PRIVACY
sections.title: Your voice stays with you.
text: Recording, transcription and search all happen on your iPhone. Audio and transcripts stay on your devices: no account, no cloud, no analytics, no tracking. The only download is Apple’s speech model for your language, which iOS may fetch once.

cta.title: Start recording.
cta.text: Free on the App Store. No account required.
